runtime.command_template: python tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <libpinmame> --game fg_1200ag --rom-path <vpinmame-roms> --work-dir <new-isolated-state> --handle-mechanics 0 --ready-timeout 90 --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/stern/family-guy-2007-evil-monkey-probe.json --dmd-dir <external-dmd-dir> --output <external-run.json>. Every public switch write is a host stimulus, never a ROM observation; the observations are the public solenoids that changed during each step. Evil Monkey switch 35 starts closed. Public solenoid 20 (the Stewie stepper homing) and 24 (the credit-sound output) change during most steps and are listed in each label but not counted as responses.

Chris target (switch 3) hit, switch 35 still closed: public 1 changed 6 times, public 27 changed 17 times

switch 35 closes again: public 1 changed 2 times
Chris target (switch 3) hit again: public 1 changed 2 times, public 27 changed 18 times

source.attribution: Generated locally from pinned PinMAME and the user-authorized ROM corpus; ROM bytes remain external. Public switch writes are host stimuli, never ROM observations. The runner can checkpoint only segment-display text, so the DMD service-menu navigation is counted key pulses; every retained DMD frame was read visually and each diagnostic snapshot's interpreted_text is that reading of its pixel SHA-256.
